ANNEX.text: TAPE RECORDER FOUND IN ANNEX: [LOUD STATIC] ...${c.lead} here. The corridor walls are absorbing sound. I yelled for ${c.custodian} earlier and the echo... didn't come back. It just stopped. [CLICK]

ARCHIVE.text: TAPE RECORDER FOUND IN ARCHIVE: [PAGES TURNING, THEN CLOSE BREATHING] ...the codes were never to keep us out. The records lock is the pour year and the open pen, two digits each, and I am saying it out loud onto tape because paper here gets reclassified and I have watched it happen. [CLICK]

IMPOUND.text: TAPE RECORDER FOUND IN IMPOUND, PEN ${pen}: [CHAINLINK SHIVERING] ...I found ${c.lost}'s recorder in the cage. It's still spinning. There's no tape inside it. I'm recording this onto the outside of that, somehow. [CLICK]

INCINERATOR.text: TAPE RECORDER FOUND IN INCINERATOR, BAY 2: [ROAR OF COMBUSTION, THEN IT DROPS OUT ENTIRELY] ...hour ${hrs}. ${c.archivist} was right. Kill the burners and the sound underneath them doesn't stop. It isn't a machine; it's alive and it breathes. [STATIC]

BOARDROOM.text: TAPE RECORDER FOUND IN BOARDROOM: [CHAIRS BEING PULLED OUT, COUNTED ALOUD] ...eleven. [PAUSE] Eleven of us came in. Somebody tell me why there are twelve of us now, and why can't I tell which one of you is not supposed to be here? [CLICK]

SERVER.text: TAPE RECORDER FOUND IN SERVER FARM: [FAN NOISE, THEN SUDDEN SILENCE] ...there. Fans are off. You can hear it now. Like I said, that's not the cooling unit. That's a carrier signal and it's been hiding under the fan noise this whole time. [STATIC]

CHECKPOINT.text: TAPE RECORDER FOUND IN CHECKPOINT: [GATE CYCLING REPEATEDLY, NOBODY PASSING] ...forty-one out, forty in, and the gate is still counting. ${c.lost} scanned in at hour ${hrs} and the machine still thinks they're inside. So do I. [CLICK]

ATRIUM.text: TAPE RECORDER FOUND IN ATRIUM: [A CART WHEEL TICKING, FAR BELOW] ...I walked up. That's the part I need on record. There is no stair to this tier and I walked up, and I can see the aisles from here, and they are not where the planogram says they are. [CLICK]

CLINIC.text: TAPE RECORDER FOUND IN CLINIC: [PEN ON PAPER, UNHURRIED] ...I'm holding the chart. Nobody is holding the pen. It's ${c.lost}'s hand, I'd know it anywhere, and it is writing down what I'm saying while I say it. [CLICK]

MAINTENANCE.text: TAPE RECORDER FOUND IN MAINTENANCE: [TAPE MEASURE RUNNING OUT, THEN RETRACTING] ...one hundred and six down. [PAUSE] Ninety-eight up. Same shaft. I'm going to keep doing this until one of us gives up. [CLICK]

CHASM.text: TAPE RECORDER FOUND IN CHASM: [WIND, AND A LONG DROP UNDER IT] ...there's somebody on the far catwalk. I'm looking straight at them. That span was cut for scrap before we opened. They just waved at me with ${c.lost}'s arm. [STATIC]
